subject: How to supress graphics window in arrangeGrob?

messages.author: ff42271ef6191bca
messages.subject: How to supress graphics window in arrangeGrob?
parts:
When i use arrangeGrob to arrange graphs, it always opens a graphics window on my Mac OS X platform.

This is also documented in the manual as a side-effect. This would only happen if "plot=T".
So how do i tell arrangeGrob not to open a window?

I am working on Mac OS X 10.7.5 with the latest R version (3.1.1) and libraries.

Regards,
Herbert
